one_liner: NotebookLM is an AI-powered research and note-taking assistant that helps users organize and interact with information from various sources.
auth_notes: Access to the enterprise API is managed via Google Cloud IAM roles.
gate_notes: The consumer NotebookLM product does not offer a self-serve public API key. An official API exists for the enterprise version, requiring Google Cloud project setup and IAM role assignment.
verdict_reason: An official API exists for the enterprise version of NotebookLM, accessible via Google Cloud IAM roles. The consumer version lacks a public API, but unofficial wrappers are available. Access to the official API requires approval/setup within a Google Cloud project.

evidence.quote: In your Google Cloud project, assign the Cloud NotebookLM User Identity and Access Management (IAM) role to the users with whom you want to share the notebook.
